verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has nothing on an automation feature in Next.js, or on any way to version, review, or roll back automations. The listed docs cover rendering, routing, API routes, codemods, an MCP endpoint and self-hosting, none of which is about managing automations. A framework could plausibly ship workflow or automation features, so the axis applies, but there is no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
